contract.gp: Original cached retained GP complete-scan position scores and native grid mean; no changes or new fits
contract.interpolation: Probability-surface bilinear interpolation from the original rectangular 2m grid, computed by logsumexp; no extrapolation
contract.pool: Fixed0.5*original Hurdle log mass+0.5*interpolated GP log density, normalized over original candidate entries
contract.candidates: Unchanged Hurdle H-unique coordinates plus empirical S entries, retaining coordinate duplicates
contract.controls: Original Hurdle, native GP, candidate-grid GP endpoint, native-coordinate half; no new temperature or selected weight
contract.question: What changes when only det is refitted with detection_ipw20, inheriting mean/scale and keeping identical H/S, candidates, reader and fixed pool?
contract.adoption: No automatic adoption rule; report original-vs-new single path and fixed pool effects and deltas for main-thread judgment; no target-selected threshold
contract.counterexamples: Flat GP tempers Hurdle rather than disappearing; both confident and wrong can compound error; mismatched or out-of-grid candidates stop this cache path
contract.scope: Predictive combination with overlapping H/S and Query, not independent Bayesian evidence; existing exposed development events
contract.ordering: Original core eagerly parses CSV; explicit H/S and RSS only predict, save all method predictions per event before truth-based scoring
